label: endRunDropped: the adapter drops its forward to endRun, so a nudge after a save merges into the saved step (a run spans two gestures) and undo skips past the saved document
refusalIsSuccess: the adapter maps the kernel's refusal of a file with no version to success, so it opens as version 1
savedTokenDropped: a save never sets the saved token, so the saved document still reads dirty
forwardDropped: the session no longer forwards the current step, so an edit never reads dirty on the session
